title: YEEZY 500
description: Kanye West and adidas launched the Yeezy 500 ‘Utility Black’ in July 2018. The retro-inspired silhouette counterbalances its bulky form with a sleek, all-black design. What sets this colorway apart from the standard triple-black finish is a singular use of tone – it’s a semi-faded black that coats the combination mesh and suede upper, as opposed to the pitch-black variety that’s more common in the sneaker firmament.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant adapts Kanye West's groundbreaking design—initially launched in September 2016—in a kid-friendly build. Revealed in September 2019, this Citrin variant boasts a non-reflective Primeknit bootie featuring an asymmetrical stitch pattern, integrated lacing and a post-dyed translucent stripe across the lateral side. Infused with energy-filled Boost technology, the two-tone sole completes the look.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Covellite’ showcases a mix of navy, indigo, and grey tones throughout the re-engineered Primeknit upper. The camo-like design is punctuated by perforated detailing that accompanies the sneaker’s semi-translucent monofilament window, woven into the side panel to enhance the breathability of the sock-like build. Responsive cushioning arrives via a caged full-length Boost midsole, featuring a stacked, elevated heel and supported underfoot by a herringbone rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Infants ‘Bone’ utilizes a one-piece polyester upper secured with no-tie bungee laces, enabling convenient and easy on and off for little feet. The understated color scheme is enlivened with reflective silver accents, highlighted by 700 branding on the sneaker’s lateral side. A sculpted PU midsole in contrasting black houses a full-length Boost unit, visible through cut-outs in the rubber outsole.
